title.narrative: Common understanding of key challenges, waste and energy sector needs and detailed work planning as well as in-depth knowledge of present situation and pre-feasibility of organic waste and Waste to Energy potentials.

Reports on activities. • Initial mission with high-level minister participation in Q1 2020 • Sustainability workshops held on October 20th 2020 (for Lombok) and April 20th 2021 (Kepri). • Danish Island-webinars (three joint webinars) conducted in June 2021. Experts and delegates from Bornholm and Samsø had prepared presentations related to their initiatives, progress and visions on waste management • A study tour to Denmark was conducted Q4 2022 with visits on the islands of Bornholm and Samsø, including meetings with mayors, civil servants, workshop at Samsø and site visits. • Launch workshops at Q2 2023 held at each of the two Islands; partners and other stakeholders were gathered and the results of the SII project were presented and discussed

actual.value: The Danish Minister of Environment and the Governor of West Nusa Tenggara, inaugurated the SII project in Mataram on February2020. Another workshop was also organized and hosted by the local authorities of Batam and Kepri in Batam city.
Workshops, webinars, pre-feasibility study and assessments completed, however, a visit to Denmark was postponed (again) due to COVID-19
• Reports on regulatory and financial barriers and solutions for WtE under preparation (to be published Q1 2023) BOFA, to visit both Lombok and Batam/Kepri three times (Q3 2022 and Q1 2023)

• Study Tour to Denmark for local decision makers and senior officials, Oct-Nov. 2022. • Waste Study for Riau with description and analysis of framework, institutions and challenges (National Consultant) • Two missions by DEA and Viegand Maagoe to gather data, conduct interviews, give presentations, host workshops and do local site visits (1st mission in August and 2nd in November) • Reports on “Waste-to-energy potential and project development guidelines for Batam/Lombok” published (November) • Visit by BOFA, Oct-Nov. 2022, with seminars, site visits and dialogues on selected topics within circular economy, WtE and waste management.
